Technical SEO.title: November 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update Done, AI Overviews, Help Docs, Local & Earnings
Technical SEO.summary: The November 2026 Google Webmaster Report recaps all major organic search changes, noting that the September 2026 spam update completed in October and that several unconfirmed algorithm updates were observed while the next core update is still pending.

Technical SEO.title: Google Lighthouse Update Changes How PageSpeed Insights Simulates Loading
Technical SEO.summary: A Google Lighthouse update changes how PageSpeed Insights simulates page loads, which can cause lab scores to rise on pages that have not actually changed. Enterprise SEO teams should audit PageSpeed scores to distinguish real performance gains from simulation changes.

Technical SEO.title: Gary Illyes Implies Click Data Not Coming To Google Search Console AI Reporting
Technical SEO.summary: Google's Gary Illyes indicated that click and query data are likely not coming to the AI performance report in Search Console, saying the team wants to bring data that makes sense but did not confirm those metrics. This has direct implications for measuring AI Overviews traffic at the enterprise level.

Technical SEO.title: Google Says No AI Click Reporting News Yet, Ahead Of UK Deadline
Technical SEO.summary: Google confirmed it has nothing to announce regarding adding more AI search performance data to Search Console, even as a UK compliance deadline approaches. This affects enterprise SEOs tracking organic visibility in AI-served results.

Technical SEO.title: Reddit Stock Drops 33% After CEO Confirms Declining Google Search Traffic
Technical SEO.summary: Reddit's stock fell over 30% after CEO Steve Huffman confirmed that Google Search traffic to the platform has been declining, a signal of shifting referral patterns that enterprise content strategists should monitor for UGC-reliant verticals.

Technical SEO.title: Google Says Technical SEO Remains Key For AI SEO
Technical SEO.summary: Google's John Mueller cautioned against relying on short-term AI SEO tactics and stated that traditional technical SEO remains relevant as AI search evolves. The guidance reinforces crawlability and indexation as foundational priorities even in an AI-answer environment.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Shopping: Get Your Products Found In Google & ChatGPT
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Presenters Chris Sachs and Aris Vrakas outlined four moves for AI shopping visibility: make product pages retrievable, use shopper language, connect feeds with pages, and test results across platforms. The framework is directly applicable to enterprise e-commerce and travel catalog optimization.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: 3 AI Models Shopped Shopify's Catalog and Each Picked A Different Winner
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Three different AI models evaluated the same product catalog and recommended different products, highlighting that the AI shopping decision layer operates as a black box with no monitoring equivalent to traditional rank tracking. This finding has direct relevance for brands optimizing product visibility across AI surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Search Ad Visits Out-Earned ChatGPT Ads In U.S.
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Data shows that ChatGPT ad visits generated a fraction of the revenue per visit that Google paid search delivered in U.S. traffic, with most advertisers seeing no sales from ChatGPT ad traffic. The comparison provides useful context for enterprise budget allocation across paid and organic AI-adjacent channels.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: NY Times Accuses Brave Of Scraping And Exploiting Content
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The New York Times filed a lawsuit accusing Brave of selling access to paywalled content to AI companies and depriving publishers of advertising revenue. The case has strategic implications for enterprise publishers and travel media brands managing content licensing and AI scraping exposure.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews For Brands Moved To Right Column
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has repositioned AI Overviews for many brand-related keywords from the top or middle of the main results to the right-hand column of the search results page. This layout change affects how brand SERP real estate is structured and has direct implications for enterprise brand visibility strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Supporting a shared AI training control for websites
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google published guidance on a shared AI training control mechanism for websites, addressing how site owners can signal preferences around AI training use of their content. This is directly relevant to enterprise publishers and travel brands managing content rights across AI platforms.

AI Search / GEO.title: Every AI follow-up question is another SEO opportunity
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land argues that each follow-up question a user asks in an AI search session represents a distinct SEO and content visibility opportunity for brands. The framing is useful for enterprise GEO strategy focused on multi-turn AI query coverage.

AI Search / GEO.title: What Generative Engine Optimization Means for the Restaurant That Isn't Recommended
AI Search / GEO.summary: Hospitality Net examines the business consequences for travel and hospitality operators that do not appear in AI-generated recommendations, framing GEO as an existential visibility issue for the sector. The hospitality angle makes this directly applicable to cruise and travel enterprise SEO strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT search volume has reached about one-fifth of Google's
AI Search / GEO.summary: OpenAI has stated that ChatGPT search volume has grown to approximately one-fifth of Google's search volume, signaling a material shift in the AI search landscape that enterprise SEO and GEO programs need to account for in channel strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse tracks which domains are most frequently cited across major AI answer engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, providing a benchmark for enterprise brands assessing their GEO citation coverage relative to competitors.
